title: S04 — Statement of Architecture Work
body:
# S04 — Statement of Architecture Work

## Assignment

The S04 slice (issue #3) under the programme's architecture governance; the live delivery
contract is `01a2054c-4cab-752d-a62d-9446c9274d70`.

## Scope

The declaration, the registry, the served spec, the invocation path and the external ingest. Not
in scope: screens, the board and the tool platform.

## Responsibilities

The delivery team implements and proves the clauses; the programme manager routes the gates; the
Board approves the contract; the programme board reviews the tranche.

## Acceptance criteria

SPEC_V2 §12 S04 and `acceptance/programme/S04.toml`; the manifest is the gate, not this document.

## Contract

The live `delivery_contract` `01a2054c-4cab-752d-a62d-9446c9274d70`, approved by the Board under the standing delegation.
